_note: Launch services (D-024), grouped into three lines (D-025). Owners' own descriptions with quality claims removed (C-033). Scope and prices come from the owner's sample site (D-029): each carries its CLAIMS.md id and `pending: true` until that row is approved; pending items render in development only. Prices are integer paise (D-004) and also need `showPrices` in site.config.json. The equipment line's ways (rent, buy, sell back) are pending (C-099, D-044): production shows its approved `summary` (C-098) instead. Each service (and the equipment line) also carries a `detail` block for its page `/services/<slug>` (D-043): who it's for, what's included and the service's own route steps from the founders' deck, pending as C-088..C-095. Draft copy until the owners approve (Q15).
